concepts.def: Phase when the Moon is between Earth and the Sun; the lit side faces away from Earth.
Right half of the Moon (Northern Hemisphere) is lit, one week after New Moon.
Earth is between Sun and Moon; the entire near side appears lit.
Left half of the Moon (Northern Hemisphere) is lit, three weeks after New Moon.
Time between successive same phases (e.g., New Moon to New Moon): 29.5 days.
Waxing = increasing lit fraction; waning = decreasing lit fraction.
